# Statement Extract

> Extract data from bank statements, invoices & documents instantly using AI.

Statement Extract is an AI-powered document processing platform that extracts structured data from bank statements, invoices, contracts, and other financial documents. It uses Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) technology that requires no templates, no training, and delivers instant results.

## Documentation

- [Home](https://statementextract.com/)
- [Bank Statement to Excel/CSV](https://statementextract.com/convert-bank-statement-to-csv-excel/)
- [Invoice to Excel](https://statementextract.com/convert-invoice-to-excel-csv/)
- [Bank Statement to QuickBooks](https://statementextract.com/convert-bank-statement-to-quickbooks-xero/)
